Strands are stateless — they receive queue\n//! state and return a candidate or nothing.\n//!\n//! Depends on: `types`, `config`, `bead_store`.\n\nmod explore;\nmod knot;\npub mod mend;\nmod pluck;\npub mod pulse;\npub mod reflect;\npub mod splice;\npub mod unravel;\npub mod weave;\n\nuse std::collections::HashSet;\nuse std::time::Instant;\n\nuse anyhow::Result;\n\nuse crate::bead_store::BeadStore;\nuse crate::config::Config;\nuse crate::span::{attrs, strand_results};\nuse crate::types::{Bead, BeadId, StrandResult};\n\n/// A single strand evaluation result.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct StrandEvaluation {\n    pub strand_name: String,\n    pub result: String,\n    pub duration_ms: u64,\n}\n\n/// Result of a single `StrandRunner::select()` call.\n///\n/// Carries both the winning candidate (if any) and diagnostic statistics\n/// about restarts that occurred during the waterfall — used to populate\n/// `worker.exhausted` telemetry with a per-iteration breakdown.\n#[derive(Debug, Default)]\npub struct SelectOutcome {\n    /// The candidate bead and the strand that found it, or `None` if\n    /// all strands returned `NoWork`.\n    pub bead: Option<(Bead, String)>,\n    /// How many times the waterfall restarted from Pluck (cap = `MAX_RESTARTS`).\n    pub waterfall_restarts: u32,\n    /// Names of strands that returned `WorkCreated` and triggered a restart.\n    /// Duplicate entries are preserved (one per restart event).\n    pub restart_triggers: Vec<String>,\n    /// All strand evaluations in order, across all waterfall passes.\n    /// Each entry is (strand_name, result, duration_ms).\n    pub strand_evaluations: Vec<StrandEvaluation>,\n    /// The strand span guard for the strand that found the bead.\n    /// This keeps the strand span active through the bead lifecycle.\n    /// Dropped when the bead lifecycle ends (in do_log).\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    pub strand_span_guard: Option<tracing::span::EnteredSpan>,\n    /// If set, this bead should be dispatched with a split prompt instead of\n    /// the normal work prompt. Contains the consecutive failure count.\n    pub split_failure_count: Option<u32>,\n}\n\npub use explore::ExploreStrand;\npub use knot::KnotStrand;\npub use mend::{cleanup_orphaned_in_progress, MendStrand};\npub use pluck::PluckStrand;\npub use pulse::PulseStrand;\npub use reflect::{CliReflectAgent, ReflectAgent, ReflectStrand};\npub use splice::SpliceStrand;\npub use unravel::{UnravelAgent, UnravelStrand};\npub use weave::{CliWeaveAgent, WeaveAgent, WeaveStrand};\n\n/// A single selection strategy in the waterfall.\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\npub trait Strand: Send + Sync {\n    /// Human-readable name for telemetry.\n    fn name(&self) -> &str;\n\n    /// Evaluate this strand against the current queue state.\n    async fn evaluate(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore, exclusions: &HashSet<BeadId>) -> StrandResult;\n}\n\n/// Runs strands in order, returning the first candidate found.\npub struct StrandRunner {\n    strands: Vec<Box<dyn Strand>>,\n    telemetry: crate::telemetry::Telemetry,\n}\n\nimpl StrandRunner {\n    pub fn new(strands: Vec<Box<dyn Strand>>) -> Self {\n        StrandRunner {\n            strands,\n            telemetry: crate::telemetry::Telemetry::new(\"strand-runner\".to_string()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Build the default strand waterfall from config.\n    ///\n    /// The waterfall order is:\n    /// Pluck → Mend → Explore → Weave → Unravel → Pulse → Reflect → Splice → Knot.\n    pub fn from_config(\n        config: &Config,\n        worker_id: &str,\n        registry: crate::registry::Registry,\n        telemetry: crate::telemetry::Telemetry,\n    ) -> Self {\n        let pluck = PluckStrand::with_persistent_records(\n            config.strands.pluck.exclude_labels.clone(),\n            config.strands.pluck.split_after_failures,\n            telemetry.clone(),\n            config.workspace.home.clone(),\n            config.strands.pluck.persistent_starvation_records,\n        );\n\n        let heartbeat_dir = config.workspace.home.join(\"state\").join(\"heartbeats\");\n        let heartbeat_ttl = std::time::Duration::from_secs(config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs);\n        let lock_dir = std::path::PathBuf::from(\"/tmp\");\n        let log_dir = config\n            .telemetry\n            .file_sink\n            .log_dir\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| config.workspace.home.join(\"logs\"));\n        let retention_days = config.telemetry.file_sink.retention_days;\n        let traces_dir = config.workspace.default.join(\".beads\").join(\"traces\");\n        let trace_retention_failed_days = config.strands.learning.trace_retention_failed_days;\n        let trace_retention_success_days = config.strands.learning.trace_retention_success_days;\n\n        // Create a new Registry instance pointing to the same path for ExploreStrand.\n        // We need to get the state_dir_for_explore before moving registry to MendStrand.\n        let state_fallback = config.workspace.home.join(\"state\");\n        let state_dir_for_explore = registry.path().parent().unwrap_or(&state_fallback);\n        let explore_registry = crate::registry::Registry::new(state_dir_for_explore);\n\n        let mend = MendStrand::new(\n            config.strands.mend.clone(),\n            heartbeat_dir,\n            heartbeat_ttl,\n            lock_dir,\n            worker_id.to_string(),\n            registry,\n            telemetry.clone(),\n            log_dir,\n            retention_days,\n            traces_dir,\n            trace_retention_failed_days,\n            trace_retention_success_days,\n            config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            config.strands.learning.max_learnings,\n            config.workspace.home.join(\"state\"),\n            config.limits.clone(),\n        );\n\n        let state_base = config.workspace.home.join(\"state\");\n\n        let explore = ExploreStrand::new(\n            config.strands.explore.clone(),\n            config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            explore_registry,\n            telemetry.clone(),\n            worker_id.to_string(),\n        );\n\n        let weave = WeaveStrand::new(\n            config.strands.weave.clone(),\n            config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            state_base.join(\"weave\"),\n            Box::new(CliWeaveAgent::new(config.agent.default.clone())),\n            telemetry.clone(),\n        );\n\n        let unravel = UnravelStrand::new(\n            config.strands.unravel.clone(),\n            config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            state_base.join(\"unravel\"),\n            Box::new(unravel::CliUnravelAgent::new(config.agent.default.clone())),\n            telemetry.clone(),\n        );\n\n        let pulse = PulseStrand::new(\n            config.strands.pulse.clone(),\n            config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            state_base.join(\"pulse\"),\n            telemetry.clone(),\n        );\n\n        // Create the extraction agent if configured.\n        let reflect_agent = config\n            .strands\n            .reflect\n            .extraction_agent\n            .as_ref()\n            .map(|agent_cmd| {\n                Box::new(reflect::CliReflectAgent::new(\n                    agent_cmd.clone(),\n                    config.strands.reflect.extraction_prompt_template.clone(),\n                )) as Box<dyn reflect::ReflectAgent>\n            });\n\n        let reflect = ReflectStrand::new(\n            config.strands.reflect.clone(),\n            config.workspace.default.clone(),\n            state_base.join(\"reflect\"),\n            telemetry.clone(),\n            reflect_agent,\n        );\n\n        // Reconstruct heartbeat_dir for Splice (same path used by Mend).\n        let splice_heartbeat_dir = config.workspace.home.join(\"state\").join(\"heartbeats\");\n        let runner_telemetry = telemetry.clone();\n\n        // VALIDATION: Warn loudly if Splice is enabled but report_workspace is unset.\n        // This is a critical configuration gap - without report_workspace, Splice will\n        // silently fail to create escalation beads, missing the entire point of detection.\n        if config.strands.splice.enabled && config.strands.splice.report_workspace.is_none() {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                \"━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 Splice strand is ENABLED but strands.splice.report_workspace is NOT SET!\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 Worker failure and live-loop detection will NOT create escalation beads.\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 To fix, add to your ~/.config/needle/config.yaml:\\\n                 \\n\\\n                   strands:\\\n                     splice:\\\n                       report_workspace: /path/to/your/workspace\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 Or set NEEDLE_STRANDS__SPLICE__REPORT_WORKSPACE=/path/to/workspace\\\n                 \\n\\\n                 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        let splice = SpliceStrand::new(\n            config.strands.splice.clone(),\n            splice_heartbeat_dir,\n            state_base.join(\"splice\"),\n            telemetry,\n        );\n\n        let knot = KnotStrand::new(config.strands.knot.clone(), runner_telemetry.clone());\n        StrandRunner {\n            strands: vec![\n                Box::new(pluck),\n                Box::new(mend),\n                Box::new(explore),\n                Box::new(weave),\n                Box::new(unravel),\n                Box::new(pulse),\n                Box::new(reflect),\n                Box::new(splice),\n                Box::new(knot),\n            ],\n            telemetry: runner_telemetry,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Run the waterfall, returning a `SelectOutcome` that carries the winning\n    /// candidate (if any) plus restart diagnostics.\n    ///\n    /// Returns the full `Bead` (including its workspace path) so the caller\n    /// can create the correct bead store for remote beads found by Explore.\n    /// The accompanying `String` is the name of the strand that produced the\n    /// candidate.\n    ///\n    /// When a strand returns `WorkCreated`, the waterfall restarts from Pluck.\n    /// A restart cap prevents infinite loops (e.g. a strand that always creates\n    /// work without producing a claimable bead).\n    pub async fn select(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        exclusions: &HashSet<BeadId>,\n    ) -> Result<SelectOutcome> {\n        const MAX_RESTARTS: u32 = 3;\n        let mut restarts = 0u32;\n        let mut restart_triggers: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n        let mut strand_evaluations: Vec<StrandEvaluation> = Vec::new();\n\n        'waterfall: loop {\n            for strand in &self.strands {\n                let strand_name = strand.name().to_string();\n                let strand_span = tracing::info_span!(\n                    \"strand.{}\",\n                    strand_name,\n                    needle.strand.name = %strand_name,\n                );\n                let strand_enter = strand_span.entered();\n\n                let start = Instant::now();\n                let result = strand.evaluate(store, exclusions).await;\n                let elapsed_ms = start.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;\n\n                // Record strand evaluation result as span attribute.\n                let (result_str, should_record) = match &result {\n                    StrandResult::BeadFound(beads) => {\n                        let count = beads.len();\n                        (\n                            format!(\"{}({})\", strand_results::BEAD_FOUND, count),\n                            count > 0,\n                        )\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::WorkCreated => (strand_results::WORK_CREATED.to_string(), true),\n                    StrandResult::NoWork => (strand_results::NO_WORK.to_string(), true),\n                    StrandResult::Error(_) => (strand_results::ERROR.to_string(), true),\n                    StrandResult::Skipped { reason } => (format!(\"skipped({})\", reason), true),\n                    StrandResult::Split(_, _failure_count) => {\n                        (format!(\"{}({})\", strand_results::BEAD_FOUND, 1), true)\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::FoundButExcluded => (\"found_but_excluded\".to_string(), true),\n                };\n                tracing::Span::current().record(attrs::NEEDLE_STRAND_RESULT, &result_str);\n                tracing::Span::current().record(attrs::NEEDLE_STRAND_DURATION_MS, elapsed_ms);\n\n                // Set strand span status: Error for strand errors, Ok for all other results\n                // Note: Skipped is not an error - it's expected for roam-only workers\n                if matches!(result, StrandResult::Error(_)) {\n                    tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_code\", 2u64);\n                    tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_description\", &result_str);\n                }\n\n                // Only record evaluations that produced meaningful results.\n                // Skip recording empty BeadFound results since they don't\n                // represent actual strand activity.\n                if should_record {\n                    strand_evaluations.push(StrandEvaluation {\n                        strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                        result: result_str.clone(),\n                        duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                    });\n                }\n\n                match result {\n                    StrandResult::BeadFound(beads) => {\n                        // Filter out beads that are in the exclusion set (e.g.\n                        // recently race-lost).  This prevents the waterfall from\n                        // immediately re-selecting a bead that just lost a claim\n                        // race to another worker.\n                        let original_count = beads.len();\n                        let filtered: Vec<Bead> = beads\n                            .into_iter()\n                            .filter(|b| !exclusions.contains(&b.id))\n                            .collect();\n                        let excluded_count = original_count.saturating_sub(filtered.len());\n\n                        // Record queue depth for the Pluck strand (after filtering).\n                        // This samples the current queue depth for the needle.queue.depth\n                        // observable gauge, which is measured at strand evaluation.\n                        // We report depth per priority level to enable filtered views.\n                        if strand_name == \"pluck\" {\n                            use std::collections::HashMap;\n                            let mut depths: HashMap<u8, u64> = HashMap::new();\n                            for bead in &filtered {\n                                *depths.entry(bead.priority).or_insert(0) += 1;\n                            }\n                            self.telemetry.record_queue_depth(depths);\n                        }\n\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"bead_found\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            candidates = filtered.len(),\n                            excluded = excluded_count,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand found candidates\"\n                        );\n                        if let Some(bead) = filtered.into_iter().next() {\n                            // Keep the strand span active through the bead lifecycle.\n                            // The span guard will be dropped when the bead lifecycle ends.\n                            return Ok(SelectOutcome {\n                                bead: Some((bead, strand_name.clone())),\n                                waterfall_restarts: restarts,\n                                restart_triggers,\n                                strand_evaluations,\n                                strand_span_guard: Some(strand_enter),\n                                split_failure_count: None,\n                            });\n                        }\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::Split(bead, failure_count) => {\n                        let bead = *bead;\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"split\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            bead_id = %bead.id,\n                            failure_count,\n                            \"strand triggered split for bead with excessive failures\"\n                        );\n                        return Ok(SelectOutcome {\n                            bead: Some((bead, strand_name.clone())),\n                            waterfall_restarts: restarts,\n                            restart_triggers,\n                            strand_evaluations,\n                            strand_span_guard: Some(strand_enter),\n                            split_failure_count: Some(failure_count),\n                        });\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::WorkCreated => {\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"work_created\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        restarts += 1;\n                        restart_triggers.push(strand_name.clone());\n                        if restarts > MAX_RESTARTS {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                max_restarts = MAX_RESTARTS,\n                                \"waterfall restart cap reached, continuing to evaluate remaining strands\"\n                            );\n                            // Do NOT return None — continue evaluating remaining strands\n                            // so every strand emits telemetry and the operator can see\n                            // why the worker is idle.\n                            continue;\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            restart = restarts,\n                            \"strand created new work, restarting waterfall\"\n                        );\n                        continue 'waterfall;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::NoWork => {\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"no_work\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand returned no work\"\n                        );\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::Skipped { reason } => {\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: format!(\"skipped({})\", reason),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            reason = %reason,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand skipped\"\n                        );\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::FoundButExcluded => {\n                        if let Err(e) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"found_but_excluded\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %e,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand found candidates but all were excluded/assigned, triggering short retry\"\n                        );\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    StrandResult::Error(e) => {\n                        if let Err(te) =\n                            self.telemetry\n                                .emit(crate::telemetry::EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                                    strand_name: strand_name.clone(),\n                                    result: \"error\".to_string(),\n                                    duration_ms: elapsed_ms,\n                                })\n                        {\n                            tracing::warn!(\n                                strand = %strand_name,\n                                error = %te,\n                                \"failed to emit strand evaluated telemetry\"\n                            );\n                        }\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            strand = %strand_name,\n                            error = %e,\n                            elapsed_ms,\n                            \"strand error, continuing to next strand\"\n                        );\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            // All strands evaluated without finding work or triggering a restart.\n            return Ok(SelectOutcome {\n                bead: None,\n                waterfall_restarts: restarts,\n                restart_triggers,\n                strand_evaluations,\n                strand_span_guard: None,\n                split_failure_count: None,\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Return the names of all configured strands (for telemetry/debugging).\n    pub fn strand_names(&self) -> Vec<&str> {\n        self.strands.iter().map(|s| s.name()).collect()\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Unit tests Pulse strand: codebase health scans.\n//!\n//! Runs configured scanners (linters, test coverage, etc.) and creates beads\n//! for significant findings that exceed severity thresholds.\n//!\n//! **Guardrails:**\n//! - Opt-in only (disabled by default).\n//! - Max beads created per run.\n//! - 48-hour cooldown between runs per workspace.\n//! - Severity threshold filters minor issues.\n//! - Deduplication: issues already tracked don't create duplicate beads.\n//!\n//! **State:**\n//! - `~/.needle/state/pulse/<workspace-hash>.json` stores:\n//!   - Last run timestamp\n//!   - Set of seen issue fingerprints\n//!\n//! Depends on: `bead_store`, `config`, `telemetry`, `types`.\n\nuse std::collections::HashSet;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\nuse anyhow::{Context, Result};\nuse chrono::{DateTime, Utc};\nuse crate::types::{BeadId, StrandResult};\n\n// ─── Scanner finding (parsed from scanner output) ─────────────────────────────\n\n/// A single finding from a scanner.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ScannerFinding {\n    /// Human-readable title for the finding.\n    pub title: String,\n    /// Detailed description of the issue.\n    pub body: String,\n    /// Severity level (1=critical, 5=minor).\n    pub severity: u8,\n    /// File path if applicable.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub file_path: Option<String>,\n    /// Line number if applicable.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub line: Option<u32>,\n    /// Unique fingerprint for deduplication.\n    pub fingerprint: String,\n}\n\n// ─── Persistent state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Persisted state for the Pulse strand.\n///\n/// Tracks last run time and seen issue fingerprints for deduplication.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct PulseState {\n    /// Last time a pulse scan was run for this workspace.\n    pub last_run: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n    /// Set of issue fingerprints already seen (for dedup).\n    pub seen_fingerprints: HashSet<String>,\n}\n\nimpl PulseState {\n    /// Load state from disk, returning default if file doesn't exist.\n    fn load(path: &Path) -> Result<Self> {\n        match std::fs::read_to_string(path) {\n            Ok(data) => serde_json::from_str(&data)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to parse pulse state: {}\", path.display())),\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(Self::default()),\n            Err(e) => {\n                Err(e).with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read pulse state: {}\", path.display()))\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Persist state to disk.\n    fn save(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {\n            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to create state dir: {}\", parent.display()))?;\n        }\n        let data = serde_json::to_string_pretty(self).context(\"failed to serialize pulse state\")?;\n        std::fs::write(path, data)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to write pulse state: {}\", path.display()))\n    }\n\n    /// Check if cooldown has elapsed since last run.\n    fn is_in_cooldown(&self, cooldown_hours: i64) -> bool {\n        match self.last_run {\n            None => false,\n            Some(last) => {\n                let elapsed = Utc::now().signed_duration_since(last);\n                elapsed.num_hours() < cooldown_hours\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Check if a finding has already been seen.\n    fn has_seen(&self, fingerprint: &str) -> bool {\n        self.seen_fingerprints.contains(fingerprint)\n    }\n\n    /// Mark a finding as seen.\n    fn mark_seen(&mut self, fingerprint: &str) {\n        self.seen_fingerprints.insert(fingerprint.to_string());\n    }\n\n    /// Update the last run timestamp.\n    fn touch(&mut self) {\n        self.last_run = Some(Utc::now());\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── PulseStrand ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// The Pulse strand — runs health scanners and creates beads for findings.\npub struct PulseStrand {\n    config: PulseConfig,\n    workspace: PathBuf,\n    state_dir: PathBuf,\n    telemetry: Telemetry,\n}\n\nimpl PulseStrand {\n    /// Create a new PulseStrand.\n    ///\n    /// `state_dir` is the base directory for pulse state files\n    /// (e.g., `~/.needle/state/pulse/`).\n    pub fn new(\n        config: PulseConfig,\n        workspace: PathBuf,\n        state_dir: PathBuf,\n        telemetry: Telemetry,\n    ) -> Self {\n        PulseStrand {\n            config,\n            workspace,\n            state_dir,\n            telemetry,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Compute the state file path for a workspace.\n    fn state_file_path(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        let hash = workspace_hash(&self.workspace);\n        self.state_dir.join(format!(\"{hash}.json\"))\n    }\n\n    /// Run a scanner command and capture its output.\n    async fn run_scanner(&self, name: &str, command: &str) -> Result<String> {\n        let output = tokio::process::Command::new(\"sh\")\n            .arg(\"-c\")\n            .arg(command)\n            .current_dir(&self.workspace)\n            .output()\n            .await\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to run scanner '{}'\", name))?;\n\n        // Combine stdout and stderr for analysis\n        let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).into_owned();\n        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).into_owned();\n\n        if !stderr.is_empty() {\n            Ok(format!(\"{}\\n{}\", stdout, stderr))\n        } else {\n            Ok(stdout)\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Parse scanner output into findings.\n    ///\n    /// This is a simple heuristic parser. For production use, each scanner\n    /// should have a dedicated parser for its output format.\n    fn parse_output(&self, scanner_name: &str, output: &str) -> Vec<ScannerFinding> {\n        let mut findings = Vec::new();\n        let severity_threshold = self.config.severity_threshold;\n\n        for line in output.lines() {\n            // Skip empty lines and summary lines\n            if line.trim().is_empty() || line.contains(\"warning:\") && line.contains(\"generated\") {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Heuristic: look for common patterns\n            let is_warning = line.contains(\"warning:\")\n                || line.contains(\"WARN\")\n                || line.to_lowercase().contains(\"warning\");\n            let is_error = line.contains(\"error:\")\n                || line.contains(\"ERROR\")\n                || line.to_lowercase().contains(\"error:\");\n\n            if !is_warning && !is_error {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Determine severity (errors are higher severity)\n            let severity = if is_error { 2 } else { 4 };\n            if severity > severity_threshold {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Extract file path if present (common patterns)\n            let file_path = extract_file_path(line);\n\n            // Generate fingerprint\n            let fingerprint = generate_fingerprint(scanner_name, line);\n\n            // Create title from the line\n            let title = if line.len() > 100 {\n                format!(\"[{}] {}...\", scanner_name, &line[..97])\n            } else {\n                format!(\"[{}] {}\", scanner_name, line.trim())\n            };\n\n            findings.push(ScannerFinding {\n                title,\n                body: line.to_string(),\n                severity,\n                file_path,\n                line: None,\n                fingerprint,\n            });\n        }\n\n        findings\n    }\n\n    /// Build the pulse prompt for agent-assisted analysis.\n    #[cfg(test)]\n    fn build_prompt(&self, scanner_name: &str, output: &str) -> String {\n        if let Some(template) = &self.config.prompt_template {\n            return template\n                .replace(\"{scanner}\", scanner_name)\n                .replace(\"{output}\", output)\n                .replace(\"{workspace}\", &self.workspace.display().to_string());\n        }\n\n        format!(\n            \"## Scanner: {}\\n\\n\\\n             **Workspace:** {}\\n\\n\\\n             **Output:**\\n```\\n{}\\n```\\n\\n\\\n             ## Task\\n\\n\\\n             Analyze the scanner output above. Identify the most significant issues \\\n             that require attention. For each issue, provide:\\n\\\n             - **title**: concise description (max 80 chars)\\n\\\n             - **body**: detailed explanation with file/location if available\\n\\\n             - **severity**: 1 (critical) to 5 (minor)\\n\\n\\\n             Output a JSON array of objects. If no significant issues, respond with: NO_ISSUES\",\n            scanner_name,\n            self.workspace.display(),\n            output\n        )\n    }\n}\n\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\nimpl super::Strand for PulseStrand {\n    fn name(&self) -> &str {\n        \"pulse\"\n    }\n\n    async fn evaluate(&self, store: &dyn BeadStore, _exclusions: &HashSet<BeadId>) -> StrandResult {\n        // Guard: disabled.\n        if !self.config.enabled {\n            tracing::debug!(\"pulse strand disabled\");\n            return StrandResult::NoWork;\n        }\n\n        // Guard: no scanners configured.\n        if self.config.scanners.is_empty() {\n            tracing::debug!(\"pulse strand: no scanners configured\");\n            return StrandResult::NoWork;\n        }\n\n        // Load persistent state.\n        let state_path = self.state_file_path();\n        let mut state = match PulseState::load(&state_path) {\n            Ok(s) => s,\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"failed to load pulse state, using defaults\");\n                PulseState::default()\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Guard: cooldown.\n        if state.is_in_cooldown(self.config.cooldown_hours as i64) {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                cooldown_hours = self.config.cooldown_hours,\n                \"pulse strand: in cooldown, skipping\"\n            );\n            self.telemetry\n                .emit(EventKind::PulseSkipped {\n                    reason: \"cooldown\".to_string(),\n                })\n                .ok();\n            return StrandResult::NoWork;\n        }\n\n        // Run scanners and collect findings.\n        let mut all_findings: Vec<(String, ScannerFinding)> = Vec::new();\n\n        for scanner in &self.config.scanners {\n            tracing::info!(\n                scanner = %scanner.name,\n                command = %scanner.command,\n                \"pulse strand: running scanner\"\n            );\n\n            self.telemetry\n                .emit(EventKind::PulseScannerStarted {\n                    scanner_name: scanner.name.clone(),\n                })\n                .ok();\n\n            let output = match self.run_scanner(&scanner.name, &scanner.command).await {\n                Ok(o) => o,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        scanner = %scanner.name,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"pulse strand: scanner failed\"\n                    );\n                    self.telemetry\n                        .emit(EventKind::PulseScannerFailed {\n                            scanner_name: scanner.name.clone(),\n                            error: e.to_string(),\n                        })\n                        .ok();\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            // Parse findings\n            let findings = self.parse_output(&scanner.name, &output);\n\n            // Filter by scanner-specific severity threshold if set\n            let threshold = scanner\n                .severity_threshold\n                .unwrap_or(self.config.severity_threshold);\n\n            for finding in &findings {\n                if finding.severity <= threshold && !state.has_seen(&finding.fingerprint) {\n                    all_findings.push((scanner.name.clone(), finding.clone()));\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Emit telemetry for this scanner\n            self.telemetry\n                .emit(EventKind::PulseScannerCompleted {\n                    scanner_name: scanner.name.clone(),\n                    findings_count: findings.len() as u32,\n                })\n                .ok();\n        }\n\n        // Update state timestamp\n        state.touch();\n\n        if all_findings.is_empty() {\n            tracing::info!(\"pulse strand: no new significant findings\");\n            if let Err(e) = state.save(&state_path) {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"pulse strand: failed to save state\");\n            }\n            return StrandResult::NoWork;\n        }\n\n        // Sort by severity (lower = more severe)\n        all_findings.sort_by_key(|(_, f)| f.severity);\n\n        // Create beads up to max_beads_per_run\n        let mut created = 0u32;\n        for (scanner_name, finding) in all_findings {\n            if created >= self.config.max_beads_per_run {\n                break;\n            }\n\n            let bead_title = format!(\"[Pulse] {}\", finding.title);\n            let bead_body = format!(\n                \"## Scanner Finding\\n\\n\\\n                 **Scanner:** {}\\n\\\n                 **Severity:** {}/5 (1=critical)\\n\\\n                 **File:** {}\\n\\n\\\n                 **Description:**\\n{}\\n\\n\\\n                 ---\\n\\\n                 This issue was detected by the pulse strand during a codebase health scan.\",\n                scanner_name,\n                finding.severity,\n                finding.file_path.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"(unknown)\"),\n                finding.body,\n            );\n            let labels: Vec<&str> = vec![\"pulse-finding\"];\n\n            match store.create_bead(&bead_title, &bead_body, &labels).await {\n                Ok(bead_id) => {\n                    tracing::info!(\n                        bead_id = %bead_id,\n                        scanner = %scanner_name,\n                        severity = finding.severity,\n                        \"pulse strand: created bead for finding\"\n                    );\n                    self.telemetry\n                        .emit(EventKind::PulseBeadCreated {\n                            bead_id: bead_id.clone(),\n                            scanner_name: scanner_name.clone(),\n                            severity: finding.severity,\n                        })\n                        .ok();\n                    state.mark_seen(&finding.fingerprint);\n                    created += 1;\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        scanner = %scanner_name,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"pulse strand: failed to create bead for finding\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Save state.\n        if let Err(e) = state.save(&state_path) {\n            tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"pulse strand: failed to save state\");\n        }\n\n        if created > 0 {\n            tracing::info!(\n                created,\n                \"pulse strand: created beads for codebase health findings\"\n            );\n            StrandResult::WorkCreated\n        } else {\n            tracing::info!(\"pulse strand: no new beads created (all findings deduplicated)\");\n            StrandResult::NoWork\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Compute a short SHA-256 hash of a workspace path (for state filenames).\nfn workspace_hash(workspace: &Path) -> String {\n    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();\n    hasher.update(workspace.display().to_string().as_bytes());\n    let result = hasher.finalize();\n    result\n        .iter()\n        .take(8)\n        .fold(String::with_capacity(16), |mut acc, b| {\n            use std::fmt::Write;\n            let _ = write!(acc, \"{b:02x}\");\n            acc\n        })\n}\n\n/// Extract file path from a scanner output line (best effort).\nfn extract_file_path(line: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    // Common patterns:\n    // - \"src/main.rs:42:5: error: ...\"\n    // - \"error[src/E001]: ...\"\n    // - \"./lib/foo.js line 42: ...\"\n\n    // Pattern: path:line:col\n    for part in line.split_whitespace().take(3) {\n        if part.contains(':')\n            && (part.contains('/')\n                || part.contains(\".rs\")\n                || part.contains(\".js\")\n                || part.contains(\".ts\")\n                || part.contains(\".py\"))\n        {\n            // Extract just the file path part (before the first colon)\n            if let Some(path) = part.split(':').next() {\n                if !path.is_empty() && path != \"error\" && path != \"warning\" {\n                    return Some(path.to_string());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    None\n}\n\n/// Generate a unique fingerprint for a finding.\nfn generate_fingerprint(scanner_name: &str, line: &str) -> String {\n    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();\n    hasher.update(scanner_name.as_bytes());\n    hasher.update(line.trim().as_bytes());\n    let result = hasher.finalize();\n    result\n        .iter()\n        .take(8)\n        .fold(String::with_capacity(16), |mut acc, b| {\n            use std::fmt::Write;\n            let _ = write!(acc, \"{b:02x}\");\n            acc\n        })\n}\n\n// ─── Unit tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use When the\n946\t/// worker is killed (e.g., by the capacity governor), this gives the atexit\n947\t/// handler a better chance to emit worker.stopped telemetry.\n948\tconst INTERRUPTIBLE_SLEEP_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_millis(100);\n949\t\n950\t/// Background emitter loop. Writes heartbeat at each interval.\n951\t///\n952\t/// Circuit breaker: after `max_consecutive_failures` consecutive write failures\n953\t/// the loop sets the shutdown flag and exits so the worker terminates instead of\n954\t/// spinning indefinitely.\n955\t///\n956\t/// Backoff: each consecutive failure doubles the inter-attempt sleep, capped at\n957\t/// [`MAX_HEARTBEAT_BACKOFF`].\n958\t///\n959\t/// Uses an interruptible sleep pattern to respond quickly to shutdown signals.\n960\t#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]\n961\tfn emitter_loop(\n962\t    shared_state: Arc<Mutex<SharedHeartbeatState>>,\n963\t    shutdown: Arc<AtomicBool>,\n964\t    heartbeat_dir: PathBuf,\n965\t    worker_id: String,\n966\t    qualified_id: String,\n967\t    workspace: PathBuf,\n968\t    started_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n969\t    interval: Duration,\n970\t    max_consecutive_failures: u32,\n971\t) {\n972\t    // Ensure the heartbeat directory exists before entering the write loop so\n973\t    // that workers self-recover if ~/.needle/state/heartbeats/ is deleted.\n974\t    if let Err(e) = std::fs::create_dir_all(&heartbeat_dir) {\n975\t        tracing::error!(\n976\t            error = %e,\n977\t            dir = %heartbeat_dir.display(),\n978\t            \"failed to create heartbeat directory\"\n979\t        );\n980\t    }\n981\t\n982\t    let mut consecutive_failures: u32 = 0;\n983\t    let mut current_sleep = interval;\n984\t    let mut elapsed = Duration::ZERO;\n985\t\n986\t    loop {\n987\t        // Interruptible sleep: check shutdown flag every 100ms instead of\n988\t        // sleeping for the full interval. This ensures the emitter responds\n989\t        // to shutdown signals quickly, giving the atexit handler a chance to\n990\t        // emit worker.stopped telemetry even if the process is killed.\n991\t        while elapsed < current_sleep {\n992\t            if shutdown.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {\n993\t                tracing::debug!(worker = %worker_id, \"heartbeat emitter shutting down\");\n994\t                return;\n995\t            }\n996\t            let sleep_dur = std::cmp::min(INTERRUPTIBLE_SLEEP_INTERVAL, current_sleep - elapsed);\n997\t            std::thread::sleep(sleep_dur);\n998\t            elapsed += sleep_dur;\n999\t        }\n1000\t        elapsed = Duration::ZERO;\n1001\t\n1002\t        let (state, current_bead, beads_processed, current_workspace, model) =\n1003\t            match shared_state.lock() {\n1004\t                Ok(guard) => (\n1005\t                    guard.state.clone(),\n1006\t                    guard.current_bead.clone(),\n1007\t                    guard.beads_processed,\n1008\t                    guard.current_workspace.clone(),\n1009\t                    guard.model.clone(),\n1010\t                ),\n1011\t                Err(_) => {\n1012\t                    // Mutex poisoned — the main thread panicked. Exit.\n1013\t                    tracing::error!(\n1014\t                        worker = %worker_id,\n1015\t                        \"shared state mutex poisoned, heartbeat emitter exiting\"\n1016\t                    );\n1017\t                    return;\n1018\t                }\n1019\t            };\n1020\t\n1021\t        // Use the current bead's workspace if set, otherwise fall back to home workspace.\n1022\t        let effective_workspace = current_workspace.unwrap_or_else(|| workspace.clone());\n1023\t\n1024\t        let is_idle = state == WorkerState::Exhausted || current_bead.is_none();\n1025\t        let current_task = current_bead.as_ref().map(|b| b.to_string());\n1026\t\n1027\t        let data = HeartbeatData {\n1028\t            worker_id: worker_id.clone(),\n1029\t            qualified_id: qualified_id.clone(),\n1030\t            pid: std::process::id(),\n1031\t            state,\n1032\t            current_bead,\n1033\t            workspace: effective_workspace,\n1034\t            last_heartbeat: Utc::now(),\n1035\t            started_at,\n1036\t            beads_processed,\n1037\t            session: worker_id.clone(),\n1038\t            is_idle,\n1039\t            current_task,\n1040\t            model,\n1041\t            heartbeat_file: None,\n1042\t        };\n1043\t\n1044\t        let path = heartbeat_dir.join(format!(\"{}.json\", qualified_id));\n1045\t        let tmp_path = path.with_extension(\"json.tmp\");\n1046\t\n1047\t        let write_result: anyhow::Result<()> = (|| {\n1048\t            // Re-assert the heartbeat directory on every attempt, not just once\n1049\t            // before the loop starts. If the directory (or an ancestor) is\n1050\t            // transiently removed or unavailable while the worker is running —\n1051\t            // e.g. an external cleanup process, a race with another tool, or a\n1052\t            // filesystem hiccup under load — the write below would otherwise\n1053\t            // fail with ENOENT on every subsequent attempt until the circuit\n1054\t            // breaker trips, since nothing else recreates it. `create_dir_all`\n1055\t            // is a cheap no-op when the directory already exists, so doing this\n1056\t            // unconditionally lets a single transient disruption self-heal\n1057\t            // within one heartbeat interval instead of killing the worker after\n1058\t            // `max_consecutive_failures` attempts (which, with the })();\n1066\t\n1067\t        match write_result {\n1068\t            Ok(()) => {\n1069\t                consecutive_failures = 0;\n1070\t                current_sleep = interval;\n1071\t %worker_id,\n1077\t                    consecutive_failures,\n1078\t                    max = max_consecutive_failures,\n1079\t                    \"heartbeat write failed\"\n1080\t       consecutive_failures,\n1085\t                        \"heartbeat emitter circuit breaker triggered — worker will shut down\"\n1086\t                    );\n1087\t                    // Emit a final heartbeat event before shutting down so the\n1088\t                    // telemetry log shows the circuit breaker was the cause.\n1089\t                    let _ = std::fs::write(\n1090\t                        heartbeat_dir.join(format!(\"{}-circuit-breaker.txt\", qualified_id)),\n1091\t                        format!(\n1092\t                            \"Circuit breaker tripped after {} consecutive heartbeat write failures\\n\\\n1093\t                             Worker: {}\\n\\\n1094\t                             Qualified ID: {}\\n\\\n1095\t                             Last error: {}\\n\\\n1096\t                             Timestamp: {}\",\n1097\t                            consecutive_failures,\n1098\t                            worker_id,\n1099\t                            qualified_id,\n1100\t                            e,\n1101\t                            Utc::now().to_rfc3339()\n1102\t                        ),\n1103\t                    );\n1104\t                    shutdown.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);\n1105\t                    return;\n1106\t                }\n1107\t                // Exponential backoff to reduce log spam before the circuit breaker fires.\n1108\t                current_sleep = current_sleep.saturating_mul(2).min(MAX_HEARTBEAT_BACKOFF);\n1109\t            }\n1110\t        }\n1111\t    }\n1112\t}\n1113\t\n1114\t// current_bead.cloned();\n            guard.current_workspace = workspace.map(|p| p.to_path_buf());\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Update the beads_processed count visible to the heartbeat emitter.\n worker's heartbeat file by removing it from disk.\n    ///\n    /// This method removes the heartbeat file at `self.heartbeat_path()`.\n    /// It returns `Ok(())` if the file is successfully removed or if it\n    /// doesn't exist. Logs a warning but returns `Ok(())` if removal fails\n    /// so cleanup failures don't prevent shutdown.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// * `Ok(())` - Always returns Ok (errors are logged, not returned)\n    pub fn cleanup_heartbeat_file(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        let path = self.heartbeat_path();\n\n        // Check if the file exists before attempting removal.\n        // This allows us to return Ok(()) for non-existent files.\n        if !path.exists() {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                path = %path.display(),\n                \"heartbeat file does not exist, skipping cleanup\"\n            );\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        // Attempt to remove the file using std::fs::remove_file.\n        match std::fs::remove_file(&path) {\n            Ok(_) => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    \"heartbeat file removed successfully\"\n                );\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                // Log the error but don't fail - cleanup is best-effort\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    error = %e,\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    \"failed to remove heartbeat file during cleanup\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Stop the heartbeat emitter and remove this worker's heartbeat file.\n    ///\n    /// Called on graceful shutdown (STOPPED) and best-effort on ERRORED.\n    pub fn stop(&mut self) {\n        // Signal the emitter thread to exit.\n        self.shutdown.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);\n\n        // Join the emitter thread (with a timeout to avoid hanging).\n        if let Some(handle) = self.emitter_handle.take() {\n            // Give the thread up to 2x the interval to notice shutdown and exit.\n            let _ = handle.join();\n        }\n\n        // Remove the heartbeat file (best-effort).\n        if let Err(e) = self.cleanup_heartbeat_file() {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                error = %e,\n                \"failed to remove heartbeat file on shutdown\"\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Path to this worker's heartbeat file.\n    ///\n    /// Keyed by fully-qualified identity (`{adapter}-{worker_id}`) to prevent\n    /// collisions when workers from different adapter pools share a NATO name.\n    ///\n    /// This path is computed during construction and stored for efficient access\n    /// by the shutdown handler.\n    pub fn heartbeat_path(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        self.heartbeat_path.clone()\n    }\n\n    /// The fully-qualified identity (`{adapter}-{worker_id}`).\n    pub fn qualified_id(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.qualified_id\n    }\n\n    /// Directory where heartbeat files are stored.\n    pub fn heartbeat_dir(&self) -> &Path {\n        &self.heartbeat_dir\n    }\n\n    /// The configured heartbeat TTL.\n    pub fn heartbeat_ttl(&self) -> Duration {\n        self.heartbeat_ttl\n    }\n\n    /// Verify that this worker's heartbeat file exists and is fresh.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `Ok(true)` if the heartbeat file exists and is within the TTL.\n    /// Returns `Ok(false)` if the heartbeat file doesn't exist or is stale.\n    /// Returns `Err` if the heartbeat file exists but cannot be read/parsed.\n    pub fn verify_heartbeat(&self) -> Result<bool> {\n        let path = self.heartbeat_path();\n        if !path.exists() {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                path = %path.display(),\n                \"heartbeat file does not exist\"\n            );\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n\n        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to read heartbeat file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        let heartbeat: HeartbeatData = serde_json::from_str(&content)\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to parse heartbeat file: {}\", path.display()))?;\n\n        let age = Utc::now()\n            .signed_duration_since(heartbeat.last_heartbeat)\n            .to_std()\n            .unwrap_or(Duration::ZERO);\n\n        let is_fresh = age <= self.heartbeat_ttl;\n        if !is_fresh {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                path = %path.display(),\n                age_secs = age.as_secs(),\n                ttl_secs = self.heartbeat_ttl.as_secs(),\n                \"heartbeat file is stale\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok(is_fresh)\n    }\n\n    // ── Reader utilities (used by peer monitoring / Mend strand) ────────────\n\n    /// Read all heartbeat files in the given directory.\n    ///\n    /// Silently skips files that cannot be read or parsed (they may be\n    /// partially written or from a crashed worker).\n    pub fn read_all_heartbeats(dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<HeartbeatData>> {\n        let mut heartbeats = Vec::new();\n\n        let entries = match std::fs::read_dir(dir) {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(heartbeats),\n            Err(e) => {\n                return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n                    \"failed to read heartbeat directory {}: {}\",\n                    dir.display(),\n                    e\n                ));\n            }\n        };\n\n        for entry in entries {\n            let entry = match entry {\n                Ok(e) => e,\n                Err(_) => continue,\n            };\n\n            let path = entry.path();\n            if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some(\"json\") {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            match std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {\n                Ok(content) => match serde_json::from_str::<HeartbeatData>(&content) {\n                    Ok(mut hb) => {\n                        // Backfill qualified_id for heartbeats written by older versions.\n                        if hb.qualified_id.is_empty() {\n                            hb.qualified_id = hb.worker_id.clone();\n                        }\n                        hb.heartbeat_file = Some(path.clone());\n                    error = %e,\n                            \"skipping unparseable heartbeat file\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                },\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::debug!(\n                        path = %path.display(),\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"skipping unreadable heartbeat file\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(heartbeats)\n    }\n\n    /// Check whether a heartbeat is stale (exceeded TTL).\n    pub fn is_stale(heartbeat: &HeartbeatData, ttl: Duration) -> bool {\n        let age = Utc::now()\n            .signed_duration_since(heartbeat.last_heartbeat)\n            .to_std()\n            .unwrap_or(Duration::ZERO);\n        age > ttl\n    }\n\n    /// Check whether a process with the given PID is alive.\n    ///\n    /// Uses `kill(pid, 0)` semantics: sends signal 0 to check existence\n    /// without actually delivering a signal. Returns true if the process\n    /// exists (including EPERM — process exists but we can't signal it).\n    pub fn check_pid_alive(pid: u32) -> bool {\n        if pid == 0 {\n            return false;\n        }\n        // SAFETY: kill(pid, 0) only checks existence; no signal is delivered.\n        let rc = unsafe { libc::kill(pid as libc::pid_t, 0) };\n        if rc == 0 {\n            return true;\n        }\n        // ESRCH means no such process. EPERM means the process exists but we\n        // lack permission to send signals to it (process is alive).\n        #[cfg(target_os = \"linux\")]\n        let errno = unsafe { *libc::__errno_location() };\n        #[cfg(target_os = \"macos\")]\n        let errno = unsafe { *libc::__error() };\n        errno == libc::EPERM\n    }\n\n    /// Detect peers with stale heartbeats.\n    ///\n    /// Returns a list of stale peers, excluding this worker.\n    pub fn detect_stale_peers(&self) -> Result<Vec<StalePeer>> {\n        let heartbeats = Self::read_all_heartbeats(&self.heartbeat_dir)?;\n        let mut stale = Vec::new();\n\n        for hb in heartbeats {\n            // Skip our own heartbeat.\n            if hb.qualified_id == self.qualified_id {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            if Self::is_stale(&hb, self.heartbeat_ttl) {\n                let pid_alive = Self::check_pid_alive(hb.pid);\n                let hb_file = hb.heartbeat_file.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {\n                    self.heartbeat_dir.join(format!(\"{}.json\", hb.qualified_id))\n                });\n                stale.push(StalePeer {\n                    worker_id: hb.worker_id.clone(),\n                    qualified_id: Some(hb.qualified_id.clone()),\n                    pid: hb.pid,\n                    pid_alive,\n                    current_bead: hb.current_bead.clone(),\n                    last_heartbeat: hb.last_heartbeat,\n                    heartbeat_file: hb_file,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(stale)\n    }\n\n    /// Detect whether a supervisor is actively managing the worker fleet.\n    ///\n    /// A supervisor is considered present when:\n    /// - Multiple active workers exist (indicating fleet management)\n    /// - OR recent worker spawn activity is detected (workers started within the last 5 minutes)\n    ///\n    /// This detection is used to warn about orphaned bead risk when `idle_action=exit`\n    /// is configured without supervisor supervision.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `Ok(true)` if supervisor presence is detected, `Ok(false)` otherwise.\n    /// Returns `Err` if heartbeat directory cannot be read.\n    pub fn detect_supervisor(&self) -> Result<bool> {\n        let heartbeats = Self::read_all_heartbeats(&self.heartbeat_dir)?;\n\n        // Filter to fresh heartbeats only (within TTL)\n        let fresh_workers: Vec<_> = heartbeats\n            .into_iter()\n            .filter(|hb| !Self::is_stale(hb, self.heartbeat_ttl))\n            .collect();\n\n        // A supervisor is present if we have multiple active workers\n        // (a single worker is likely standalone, not supervised)\n        if fresh_workers.len() >= 2 {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                active_workers = fresh_workers.len(),\n                \"supervisor detected: multiple active workers in fleet\"\n            );\n            return Ok(true);\n        }\n\n        // Check for recent spawn activity: any worker started within the last 5 minutes\n        // (excluding ourselves, as we just started)\n        let five_minutes_ago = Utc::now() - chrono::Duration::seconds(300);\n        let recent_spawns: Vec<_> = fresh_workers\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|hb| hb.qualified_id != self.qualified_id)\n            .filter(|hb| hb.started_at > five_minutes_ago)\n            .collect();\n\n        if !recent_spawns.is_empty() {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                recent_spawn_count = recent_spawns.len(),\n                \"supervisor detected: recent worker spawn activity\"\n            );\n            return Ok(true);\n        }\n\n        // No supervisor presence detected\n        tracing::debug!(\"no supervisor detected: single worker, no recent spawn activity\");\n        Ok(false)\n    }\n\n    /// Check for a supervisor heartbeat file at the standard location.\n    ///\n    /// This function provides direct supervisor presence detection by checking\n    /// for a supervisor-specific heartbeat file, separate from worker heartbeats.\n    ///\n    /// The supervisor heartbeat file is expected at:\n    /// `<heartbeat_dir>/supervisor-heartbeat.json`\n    ///\n    /// Returns `Ok(true)` if a fresh supervisor heartbeat file exists,\n    /// `Ok(false)` if no supervisor heartbeat is found or it's stale.\n    /// Returns `Err` if the heartbeat directory cannot be read.\n    ///\n    /// A heartbeat is considered fresh if updated within the last 2 minutes.\n    pub fn check_supervisor_heartbeat_file(&self) -> Result<bool> {\n        let supervisor_hb_path = self.heartbeat_dir.join(\"supervisor-heartbeat.json\");\n\n        // Check if supervisor heartbeat file exists\n        if !supervisor_hb_path.exists() {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                path = %supervisor_hb_path.display(),\n                \"supervisor heartbeat file not found\"\n            );\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n\n        // Read and parse the supervisor heartbeat file\n        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&supervisor_hb_path).with_context(|| {\n            format!(\n                \"failed to read supervisor heartbeat file: {}\",\n                supervisor_hb_path.display()\n            )\n        })?;\n\n        // Parse as JSON to verify it's valid (we don't need specific fields)\n        let parsed: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).with_context(|| {\n            format!(\n                \"failed to parse supervisor heartbeat file: {}\",\n                supervisor_hb_path.display()\n            )\n        })?;\n\n        // Check if heartbeat has a timestamp field\n        let last_heartbeat = if let Some(ts) = parsed.get(\"last_heartbeat\").and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n        {\n            DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(ts)\n                .with_context(|| {\n                    format!(\n                        \"invalid timestamp in supervisor heartbeat file: {}\",\n                        supervisor_hb_path.display()\n                    )\n                })?\n                .with_timezone(&Utc)\n        } else {\n            // No timestamp field - assume file exists but is stale/invalid\n            tracing::debug!(\n                path = %supervisor_hb_path.display(),\n                \"supervisor heartbeat file missing timestamp field\"\n            );\n            return Ok(false);\n        };\n\n        // Check if heartbeat is fresh (within 2 minutes)\n        let age = Utc::now()\n            .signed_duration_since(last_heartbeat)\n            .to_std()\n            .unwrap_or(Duration::ZERO);\n        let supervisor_ttl = Duration::from_secs(120); // 2 minutes\n\n        if age <= supervisor_ttl {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                path = %supervisor_hb_path.display(),\n                age_secs = age.as_secs(),\n                \"fresh supervisor heartbeat detected\"\n            );\n            Ok(true)\n        } else {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                path = %supervisor_hb_path.display(),\n                age_secs = age.as_secs(),\n                ttl_secs = supervisor_ttl.as_secs(),\n                \"supervisor heartbeat is stale\"\n            );\n            Ok(false)\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Check for a supervisor socket at the standard location.\n    ///\n    /// This function provides direct supervisor presence detection by checking\n    /// for a Unix domain socket that the supervisor may be listening on.\n    ///\n    /// The socket is expected at: `/tmp/needle-supervisor.sock` or a path\n    /// specified in the `NEEDLE_SUPERVISOR_SOCKET` environment variable.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `Ok(true)` if a socket exists at the expected location,\n    /// `Ok(false)` if no socket is found.\n    /// Returns `Err` if socket path cannot be accessed.\n    pub fn check_supervisor_socket() -> Result<bool> {\n        let socket_path = std::env::var(\"NEEDLE_SUPERVISOR_SOCKET\")\n            .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"/tmp/needle-supervisor.sock\".to_string());\n\n        let path = PathBuf::from(&socket_path);\n\n        // Check if socket exists and is a socket file\n        match std::fs::metadata(&path) {\n            Ok(metadata) => {\n                #[cfg(unix)]\n                {\n                    use std::os::unix::fs::FileTypeExt;\n                    let file_type = metadata.file_type();\n                    if file_type.is_socket() {\n                        tracing::debug!(\n                            path = %path.display(),\n                            \"supervisor socket detected\"\n                        );\n                        return Ok(true);\n                    }\n                }\n\n                #[cfg(not(unix))]\n                {\n %path.display(),\n                            \"supervisor socket path exists (non-Unix)\"\n                        );\n                        return Ok(true);\n                    }\n                }\n\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    path = %path.display(),\n                    \"path exists but is not a socket\"\n                );\n                Ok(false)\n found\"\n                );\n                Ok(false)\n            }\n            Err(e) => Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n                \"failed to access supervisor socket {}: {}\",\n                path.display(),\n                e\n            )),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Detect supervisor presence using direct checks.\n    ///\n    /// This function combines direct supervisor detection methods:\n    /// 1. Checks for a supervisor heartbeat file\n    /// 2. Checks for a supervisor socket\n    ///\n    /// Returns `Ok(true)` if either detection method finds a supervisor,\n    /// `Ok(false)` if no supervisor is detected.\n    /// Returns `Err` if
